card.name: Odd letter chunks in brand names
card.fires_on: Short letter chunks (like js, zf, Y, ZR, YC) inside brand names written in capitals or inside web addresses and biologic suffixes. It fires partway through the name, not on ordinary words.

modes.label: Inside capitalized brand names
modes.description: A short letter chunk after an initial Z, X, G or TY in an all-caps drug brand name.
modes.example: X<<CY>>T can cause severe or life-threatening infusion

modes.label: Web address or suffix letters
modes.description: Random-looking letters in a URL or in a four-letter suffix after a biologic's name.

card.plain: It lights up on the odd letter pieces in the middle of drug brand names and web links.
